also: when does the next train leave?

terms.gloss: when does the next train leave?
terms.comment: Traupman’s question for a bus, Quandō raeda longa discēdet? (84), with proximus, the next in order or time.

phrases.latin: Trāmen abiit. Quandō proximum discēdet? — Intrā sēmihōram.
phrases.english: The train has gone. When is the next one? — Within half an hour.

phrases.latin: Quandō raeda longa discēdet? — Mox. Profectō secundā hōrā.
phrases.english: When does the bus leave? — Soon. In fact, at eight o’clock.

sources: Lewis & Short: proximus · Lewis & Short: discedo
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 84.
